help.title: Help & Support
help.quickstart_body:
1. Pick a converter on the Dashboard or Convert screen.
2. Drop a file or press Browse.
3. Choose the output format and where to save it.
4. Press Convert. You can cancel at any time.
help.matrix_intro: ProConvert rebuilds documents from their content. Layout is not reproduced exactly. Experimental routes reconstruct structure and need your review.
help.legend_supported: Content (text, tables, images) is carried over and verified by automated tests. Layout is not identical.
help.legend_experimental: Structure is reconstructed automatically. Always review the result.
help.troubleshooting_body:
- Password-protected file: enter the password for PDFs; for Office files remove the password first.
- Scanned PDF with no text: enable OCR in Settings if an OCR engine is installed.
- Text looks different: layout, fonts and styles are rebuilt, not copied.
- Something failed: expand "Show technical details" or export diagnostics in Settings > Advanced.
help.shortcuts_body:
Ctrl+O  Open a file
Ctrl+Enter  Convert
Ctrl+1 ... Ctrl+8  Switch screens
Ctrl+B  Show or hide the menu
Alt+Left  Back to the previous screen
F1  Help
Tab / Shift+Tab  Move between controls; Enter or Space activates the focused item
help.support_body: Found a bug, or a document that converts badly? Open an issue on the project page and attach a diagnostics export (Settings > Advanced). It never contains your documents.
